# Prompt: Hallmark Redesign Bridge

## Objective
Redesign an existing UI direction and pass it through BoostDesign governance.

## Prompt
```text
Usa Hallmark en modo redesign para este target, manteniendo IA y copy.
Despues ejecuta normalizacion de tokens y auditoria UX:
- @design-system-architect para tokens/patrones
- @ux-ui-expert para accesibilidad, consistencia y estados
```

## Expected Output
- Redesigned direction with rationale.
- Token and pattern mapping.
- Governance pass/fail summary and remediation actions.
